Subject: Renewal: proposed 8→16 GPU reserved pool & monthly commit update

Hi Sarah / Kevin —

Thanks again for the productive sync last week. As discussed, AtlasAI's usage growth has you bumping against the committed throughput on your 8-GPU reserved pool. To avoid throttling and give you headroom for Q3 model rollouts, we'd like to propose converting your current reserved pool to a 16-GPU monthly commit for the next 12 months.

High-level proposal (preview):
- New monthly commit: 16x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved)
- Billing cadence: monthly with pro-rated activation in May
- Throughput guardrail: 2.0x baseline token/sec SLA; burst capacity for 48 hours/month
- Ops plan: 7x24 migration window, staged activation (8→12→16 over 7 days)

I've attached a draft amendment with the updated pricing and opt-in activation schedule (commit_amendment_v3.pdf). Can you confirm a target go-live week in May and whether procurement should expect an updated PO or a DocuSign order form?

Next steps I propose:
1) Sarah/Kevin confirm internal approval path and target go-live week.
2) We send a final amendment + DocuSign, procurement countersigns.
3) Stephanie (ops) and Laura (CS) run the activation playbook during the window.

CC'ing Stephanie and Laura to confirm ops windows and any change freezes we should avoid.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Answers below and I've embedded the specific language we'll include in the amendment.

1) SLA / throughput language (excerpt):
- Baseline throughput guarantee: sustained 2.0x tokens/sec per-GPU relative to current measured baseline (measured over 24-hour moving window).
- Latency objective: p95 generation latency for a 512-token prompt to remain under 350ms under baseline traffic.
- Failure remediation: in the event of sustained SLA miss >24 hours, AtlasAI is eligible for service credits equal to 10% of that month's reserved fee per 24-hour window (capped at 50% monthly).

2) Activation steps (staged):
- Day 0: pre-flight and key injection; no traffic cutover.
- Day 1–2: expand pool to 12 GPUs; turn on KV-prefix cache warmup jobs; monitor error rates and latency.
- Day 3–5: expand to 16 GPUs; ramp traffic by 25% increments with rollback guardrails.
- Ops window: 0200–0800 PT recommended for lowest traffic; we will provide a rollback playbook.

3) Pricing: fixed monthly rate for 12 months (no indexation). Any changes after the 12-month term will be handled in the next renewal.

4) Contracting: DocuSign is Redwood's preferred path for enterprise amendments. We can accept a PO in parallel but need the DocuSign sign-off from your authorized signee to activate the reserved capacity. I'll attach the amendment and include a DocuSign link in the next message.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/12345abcd
Attachment: commit_amendment_v3.pdf (details on pricing and SLA excerpts)

If the above looks good, I'll send the final amendment for signature and loop in Stephanie to confirm exact ops dates.

Best —
Aditya

Team —

Quick ops notes and checklist for the staged activation. I'm attaching a trimmed activation checklist (ops_activation_checklist.xlsx) but calling out the critical items here so AtlasAI can review before signature: 

- Pre-flight: confirm SSH/KMS access, KV cache seeds, and alerts integration (PagerDuty).
- Phased scaling: 8→12 (no traffic change), then traffic ramp to verify KV effectiveness, then 12→16 with 25% ramp steps.
- Monitoring: we will provide a shared Grafana dashboard and a short 4-hour burn-in post full-scale activation.
- Rollback: instant capacity rollback to 8 GPUs if p95 latency exceeds 500ms or error rate >1% sustained for 5 minutes.
- On-call: Redwood infra on-call assigned during the window; we need AtlasAI ops to have a technical contact for escalation.

Operational constraints from AtlasAI side (requested):
- No net-new model deploys within 72 hours of cutover.
- Schedule maintenance windows for 48 hours post-activation to validate telemetry.

Aditya — if the customer confirms week of May 17, I'll pencil the week and start reserving capacity. Laura — please prepare the communication playbook for customer-facing monitoring links.

Thanks —
Stephanie
